description: Develop and test a regex pattern for parsing authentication service logs. The logs are in format: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm] LEVEL component - message. You must: (1) Create a regex pattern with 4 capturing groups that extract: timestamp (group 1), log level (group 2), component name (group 3), and message text (group 4). (2) Test your pattern against the sample logs in sample_logs.txt to ensure it works on all 8 log lines. (3) Save your final pattern to a file named 'pattern.txt' in the workspace root. (4) Save test results demonstrating your pattern works to 'test_results.txt' in the workspace root. (5) Create documentation explaining your pattern in 'pattern_explanation.md' in the workspace root. The pattern must correctly parse all log lines including those with special characters in emails (e.g., +, dots), different log levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR, DEBUG), and various components (auth.login, auth.password, auth.mfa, etc.).
